description: raw-recurrence-mellum-v6 (full-depth foundation) with raw-recurrence-v7's fixup checkpoint points. autoregressive_text_fixup writes its full state at step 512 and at its end (checkpoint_every 128 -> 512): its 16k-token steps are unmeasured on Mellum (estimate 10-80 s/step), so 128 could mean a ~47 GB write every 20 min; 512 keeps writes >= ~1.4 h apart even at 10 s/step and bounds crash loss to half the stage at 80 s/step. eval_every 64 (16 points) stays: the warm-up curriculum needs about 13. Re-size once measured. History: recipes/HISTORY.md.
